android.desc:
Dipla is a local community app that helps you connect with people nearby in real time.
Once connected, you can communicate, share, and discover what’s happening around you.

The app lets you post messages, photos, and videos that stay visible to people in the same area or location as you.

With Dipla, you can:
• Share your ideas, events, and everyday moments
• Discover local activities and experiences instantly
• Connect with new people and grow your network
• Interact with posts through likes and comments
• Earn rewards for being active and engaging with your local community

By participating, posting, and interacting, you unlock rewards and exclusive benefits from nearby partners and local businesses.

Dipla brings places to life by creating a dynamic space where people can engage, interact, and get rewarded — right where they are.
